title: A refused field is named, described and marked
assertion: The summary is first in the form, on a line of its own, under "Not done"; its lead is "Fix the field listed here, then try again." for one field, "Fix the fields listed here, then try again." for several, and absent when no issue names a field; each item names its field by the label the person sees (a trailing parenthetical dropped unless it says posted or deposited; a group by its legend, a single box by its own label), links to it, and never shows a key; an issue with no field shows its message alone; under the field, "Error:" beside the message, the element that describes the field holding the message alone; the control is aria-invalid with a 2 px border in the danger color; the same refusal twice is announced twice
noFileReason: The forms are refused in a browser harness with in-memory actions, and on synthetic sign-ins and practices the seed creates; no file.
